page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs, which correspond to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The processor is backed by 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is consistently average, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is also average, though the PassMark memory score is weak.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-core throughput, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that scale across multiple threads rather than relying on high single-core clock speeds. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks using small to medium models. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing or workloads requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
